items.q: I think Quincy Jones, George Benson --

ctx.x: You know, just for acts. And then another one was Randy Crawford. I can't even think of the -- this was on Warner Brothers. I can't think of what the name of the song was, or whatever the songs were. Oh, I remember. This is a thing at the auditorium -- well, it's further back than what you're asking. I think Quincy Jones, George Benson --
Oh, the World Jazz Association concert at the Shrine Auditorium, in 1975?
